objective: Execute the unchanged v1 Columbia cross-domain confirmation design while resolving the official eye-corner archive's documented 15 missing rows through a deterministic, pre-outcome MediaPipe landmark fallback.

v1_preflight.reason: The official README documents 5,865 annotated images and 15 missing annotations, while v1 required zero missing annotations.

allowed_delta_from_v1.scope: source annotation completeness and the exact fallback for the documented missing rows only

missing_annotation_fallback.eligible_rows: only the exact 15 image identities absent from the official eye-corner CSV
missing_annotation_fallback.input: resize the original image to width 1280 preserving aspect ratio with cv2.INTER_AREA
missing_annotation_fallback.detector: the repository-pinned MediaPipe FaceLandmarker used by MediaPipeUniGazePreprocessor
missing_annotation_fallback.coordinate_mapping: multiply detected x and y coordinates by original_width/resized_width and original_height/resized_height respectively before applying the inherited v1 affine eye crop
missing_annotation_fallback.fallback_failure_policy: fail candidate completeness; do not drop, impute, hand-label, or substitute a single eye

reporting_override.candidate_metric_population: all 5880 images only if all 15 fallback rows succeed

mutation_policy.after_result: Preserve the exact result. Any outcome-driven model, sign, crop, resolution, fallback, epoch, seed, threshold, population, or metric change invalidates independence and may not be presented as a fresh Columbia confirmation.
